review.body: { if script . get (2 .. 6) == Some (b"PNAT") && script . get (6) . is_some_and (| version | * version != 2) { return Err (QualificationRefusal :: Version) ; } let script : & [u8 ; 76] = script . try_into () . map_err (| _ | QualificationRefusal :: Length) ? ; if script [.. 2] != [0x6a , 0x4a] { return Err (QualificationRefusal :: Push) ; } if script [2 .. 6] != * b"PNAT" { return Err (QualificationRefusal :: Tag) ; } if script [75] != 0 { return Err (QualificationRefusal :: Flags) ; } let mut run = [0 ; 32] ; run . copy_from_slice (& script [7 .. 39]) ; let mut prevout = [0 ; 36] ; prevout . copy_from_slice (& script [39 .. 75]) ; Ok (Qualification { run , prevout }) }
review.item_premise: Every argument and result is public and recorded in full. The byte recipes claim only their derivations; parsing precedes membership hashing, fixed message/signature lengths precede native verification, and no chain or complete act verdict is produced.
